GOOD TO KNOW

Questions, answered.

Clear expectations before you choose a guide.

Are these physical books?

No. These are digital PDF guides and workbooks. The final checkout and delivery flow will be connected once the payment provider and delivery settings are supplied.

What do I receive after purchase?

The intended delivery is a private download of the purchased PDF. The full paid files will not be exposed as public website assets.

Can I preview a guide before buying?

Yes. The preview area uses selected sample pages from each uploaded PDF, not the complete paid document.

Are the guides tax or accounting advice?

No. They are educational and operational resources. The PDFs themselves note that tax treatment, retention rules and filing requirements vary by jurisdiction and business structure.

Which guide should I start with?

Start with the Starter Kit if you need a basic system. Choose a focused guide if your immediate issue is cash flow, reconciliation, catch-up work, profit visibility, document organization, mixed personal/business transactions, automation or software selection.
